{{Quote|I'll find that hidden fortress—if I have to destroy every star system in this sector!|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="Star Wars 3">[[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]]</ref>}}
'''Alderaan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that was located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] itself before its [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. The sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by such individuals as [[Ravein]], [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]], [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]; in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Cal Omas]].
